snippet.title: Tamer Town - Monster Tamer Direct - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Welcome to Tamer Town – a city builder where tamers and their Mokitons fight, evolve, and grow bonds within a vibrant community. Design unique districts, unlock character stories, and build a warm world where every relationship matters.

➡️ Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601860/Tamer_Town/

____
Set in the same universe as Path to Tamer Town, the roguelite adventure where every tamer’s journey begins. Watch the official Announcement Trailer to see how the path leads to the town!

➡️ Path to Tamer Town on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939760/Path_to_Tamer_Town/

First revealed during Monster Tamer Direct.
